verification_scope: Frozen customer runtime reference at 1440x900 for the shared list, detail and edit states, plus one basic narrow-width reachability check.
checks_actual_results: The list reference was captured from /systems/18?workspace=runtime&module=customer at a true 1440x900 browser viewport; document scrollWidth was 1440 and no horizontal document overflow existed.
The detail reference was captured after opening existing record 18; the stable right drawer measured 520px and exposed overview, relation and history tabs plus one primary edit action.
The edit reference was captured after opening the existing record form without changing or saving data; the stable right drawer measured 560px and exposed one primary save action.

At 760x900, document scrollWidth was 745, the main work area remained readable, bottom navigation remained visible, and the new-record action remained reachable; the viewport was restored to 1440x900.
All nine shared-page files retained the exact hashes verified by B02.2. The reference capture did not change product code or business records.

screenshots.context: Published customer module list with existing representative record, no row selected and therefore no batch bar.
Existing customer record detail in the 520px right drawer after the opening animation settled.
Existing customer record edit form in the 560px right drawer; no values changed and save was not invoked.

readback: The desktop list has a clear page title, one blue new-record primary action, compact secondary actions, module navigation on the left and data on the right.
Detail and edit use the same right-side interaction model and leave enough of the source list visible to preserve context.
The unselected list omits batch actions; B02.2 already verified that the shared batch region appears only after selection.
The narrow check exercises the shared responsive fallback only. It does not claim the complete B19 mobile or accessibility matrix.

permission_or_failure_result.browser_identity: Local default platform administrator; credentials are intentionally omitted from this evidence.
permission_or_failure_result.expired_session: An initial expired-session capture was rejected and overwritten after entering the system through the real platform system-entry flow.
permission_or_failure_result.capture_timing: Initial detail/edit images were taken during the drawer opening animation and were rejected. Final images were captured after animation settlement and DOM readback confirmed 520px and 560px drawer widths.
permission_or_failure_result.data_mutation: No business create, update, delete or save action was performed in B02.3.

remaining: Complete mobile breakpoint, accessibility and cross-module visual convergence remains B19.
Other product capability pages retain their owning package work; this reference freezes the shared runtime list/detail/edit pattern rather than claiming product completion.
